messages:
elya_sales: ACME POC wrap: proposed window Thurs 09:00 PT to run deprovision. Need clear owners for: hosted API key revocation, dedicated pool (dp-12) shutdown, VPC peering/SG cleanup, logs export + archive, and legal attestation for data disposal. Can we confirm owners and whether dp-12 billing stops immediately on terminate?

infra_ops: I can take dp-12 and VPC steps. Plan: 1) mark pool read-only, 2) drain with 15m grace, 3) terminate. Commands: 
```bash
# mark read-only
rctl pool set dp-12 --mode read-only
# drain
rctl pool drain dp-12 --grace 900 --wait
# terminate
rctl pool terminate dp-12 --confirm
```
Note: termination removes instance hours from next billing cycle but commit may still bill for reserved capacity this month; tag for billing to confirm.

billing_tim: Confirmed: on-demand GPU hours stop when pool terminated; reserved commits bill until end of contract period. For this POC there's no reserved commit, so charges cease after termination. We'll send a prorated invoice if needed.

security_bot: I'll revoke any Hosted API keys and rotate any long-lived creds. Using the Admin endpoint: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"acme-poc","scope":"all","reason":"poc-terminate"}'
```
I'll attach revocation audit JSON here when done. Also recommend creating a signed destruction attestation.

maria_cs: I'll coordinate with ACME for the 09:00 PT window and confirm backups have been retrieved. Please don't run until I confirm backup link uploaded.

infra_ops: Acknowledged. I'll wait for confirmation from maria_cs. Also will export flow logs and control-plane audit before teardown: 
```bash
# export control plane logs
aws s3 cp /var/log/redwood/poc/acme-19322 s3://acme-poc-exports/1932201000 --recursive
# export VPC flow logs to s3; retain 30d
```

legal_rebecca: Per contract, default retention is 90 days for any PII unless customer signs off on immediate deletion. If ACME signs a data disposal waiver we can destroy sooner and provide attestation. I'll draft the attestation and post for signature.

elya_sales: Great. Owners so far: infra_ops = pool+vpc+logs, security_bot = keys, maria_cs = customer coord, legal_rebecca = attestation, billing_tim = invoice/billing. Everyone okay with Thurs 09:00 PT pending backup confirmation? React with :white_check_mark:.

maria_cs: :white_check_mark: I'll confirm backup by Wed EOD and post link.

security_bot: :white_check_mark: I'll schedule revocation at T+2 after logs export to ensure audit recorded.

billing_tim: :white_check_mark: I'll prepare a prorated billing note to share with ACME.

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-43122 and attached runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-teardown; will post completion summary and artifacts when done.

deploy-bot: Reminder: ensure monitoring alerts for dp-12 are muted during teardown to avoid noisy paging.

infra_ops: Noted. Once maria_cs posts backup link I'll run exports and then post timestamps for drain start/terminate.

elya_sales: Thanks team. leaving plan in thread; please post final confirmation here after completion and attach: revocation audit, S3 export link, termination timestamp, and signed attestation (or waiver).
